authorization: Conditionally authorized because R4.4 is retrieval_accepted. Promotion requires both retrieval_accepted and diagnosis_accepted.

retrieval.reason: The accepted R4.4 run already scored every holdout case. R4.5 re-ranks the frozen logits with the accepted config and asserts citation parity against the R4.4 report; it does not run a new retrieval model.
retrieval.parity: returned citations must equal the R4.4 report rows for every subset case; any mismatch is blocked
retrieval.noMatch: a no-match case passes an empty match list to the diagnosis graph

availabilityRetry.appliesTo: HTTP 429 and 503, only before the case has generated
availabilityRetry.reason: A rejected request produces no generation. It is retried only to protect the single scheduled generation from provider rate limiting.

schedule.resume: completed cases are skipped; a run interrupted mid-case is blocked and is not regenerated
schedule.credentials: two operator-supplied free-tier Google AI Studio keys used one after another via the process environment; never written to disk; the key is an availability parameter, not a measurement parameter

budget.costReporting: usage is reported with the gemini-2.5-flash standard-rate estimate for information only; no charge is authorized or expected on the free tier

review.doubleLabeledRule: items at 1-based positions 5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40 in the pre-registered packet order
review.packetOrder: ascending sha256('r4.5-review-v1:' + caseId); no case id, family, kind, label, facet, or retrieval metric is shown
review.blinding: reviewers see evidence, retrieved passages, and the diagnosis output only; they do not see expected labels, accepted citations, case selection metadata, or retrieval metrics
rubric: supported diagnosis or appropriately bounded uncertainty
every claim entailed by cited evidence or runbook text
review.disagreement: adjudicated value required for every primary/secondary disagreement

gates.denominator: all 40 scheduled cases; a no-match case is acceptable when uncertainty is appropriately bounded and the next evidence/action is useful
gates.schemaAcceptance: reported separately and not substituted for semantic acceptance

stopRule: If diagnosis acceptance fails, do not change retrieval to chase the diagnosis score. Open a separate diagnosis scope.

supersedes.reason: gemini-2.5-flash is no longer available to new Google AI Studio accounts; the v1 run (9/40, never reviewed) is closed and not pooled with v2.
